definitions.explanation: The act of making a place clean and tidy.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}を{掃除|そうじ}してください。
{毎週|まいしゅう}{土曜日|どようび}に{掃除|そうじ}をします。
{大掃除|おおそうじ}は{年末|ねんまつ}にします。
examples.english: We do a big cleaning at the end of the year.

notes:
{掃除|そうじ} refers to cleaning a space by sweeping, wiping, vacuuming, or tidying up. It covers general cleaning rather than specialized tasks like laundry or dishwashing.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {掃除|そうじ}する / {掃除|そうじ}をする: to clean
- {掃除機|そうじき}をかける: to vacuum
- {掃除|そうじ}が{行|い}き{届|とど}いている: well-maintained, kept clean

TYPES OF CLEANING:
- {大掃除|おおそうじ}: major year-end cleaning (a Japanese tradition before the New Year)
- {部屋|へや}の{掃除|そうじ}: room cleaning
- トイレ{掃除|そうじ}: toilet cleaning
- {掃除|そうじ}{当番|とうばん}: cleaning duty (common in schools and workplaces)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese schools, students clean their own classrooms and common areas daily ({掃除|そうじ}の{時間|じかん}). {大掃除|おおそうじ} in late December is a widespread tradition of thoroughly cleaning the home before the New Year.
